title: Pure Odd-Eyes
summary: Pure Odd-Eyes Pendulum build with Sky Iris, Spiral Flame Strike, and the four-summon-type Odd-Eyes Extra Deck toolbox. Destroying your own Odd-Eyes cards with Sky Iris, Four Heavenly Dragons, or Override Dragon triggers Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon in the Scale to summon any Odd-Eyes monster from the hand, Deck, or GY.

summary.title: Starters
points: Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon of the Four Heavenly Dragons (Scale 4) destroys itself in the Pendulum Zone to search any Pendulum Monster with 1500 or less ATK (locking your monsters on the field out of activating effects until you Pendulum Summon).
Sky Iris destroys 1 other face-up card you control to search any Odd-Eyes card from the Deck, and protects your Pendulum Zones from being targeted by opponent's card effects.
Spiral Flame Strike searches any Level 7 Odd-Eyes monster (such as Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon, Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon, or Odd-Eyes Pendulumgraph Dragon) from your Deck or face-up Extra Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon + Sky Iris
steps: Place Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon (Scale 8) in a Pendulum Zone and another Odd-Eyes card (such as Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon of the Four Heavenly Dragons or Performapal Odd-Eyes Seer at Scale 1).

Activate Sky Iris (or Seer / Four Heavenly Dragons) to destroy the other Odd-Eyes card; Sky Iris searches a missing Scale or Odd-Eyes Pendulumgraph Dragon, while Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon triggers to Special Summon Performapal Odd-Eyes Valet, Odd-Eyes Persona Dragon, or Performapal Odd-Eyes Synchron from the Deck.

Pendulum Summon your Level 7s and Tuners, climb into Odd-Eyes Solblaze Dragon and Odd-Eyes Override Dragon (which destroys a Pendulum to draw 1 card and unlock a second Pendulum Summon), and overlay two Level 7s into Odd-Eyes Absolute Dragon, then link Absolute Dragon and another Dragon into Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres so Absolute Dragon summons Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: The Arc Pendulum Engine
summary.text: Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon is the heartbeat of the pure build: once per turn, whenever an Odd-Eyes card(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect—whether on your turn via Sky Iris, Performapal Odd-Eyes Butler, Performapal Odd-Eyes Seer, or Odd-Eyes Override Dragon, or on the opponent's turn—Arc Pendulum Special Summons any Odd-Eyes monster from your hand, Deck, or GY.

summary.title: Extra Deck & Ritual Payoff
points: Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon bounces an opponent's face-up Attack Position monster on Special Summon, and shuffles a face-up Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck into the Deck to negate any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation.

Odd-Eyes Pendulumgraph Dragon (Ritual or Pendulum Summoned) burns for 300 on every opponent Extra Deck summon and moves itself to the Pendulum Zone to negate a Spell Card or effect and summon an Odd-Eyes from the Extra Deck.

Odd-Eyes Override Dragon (Link-3) grants a second Pendulum Summon and discards to negate an effect activated on your turn; Odd-Eyes Solblaze Dragon (Level 8 Synchro Tuner) summons a face-up Pendulum from the Extra Deck and revives itself from the GY.

Odd-Eyes Raging Dragon, Odd-Eyes Rebellion Dragon, and Odd-Eyes Rebellion Xyz Dragon provide Rank 7 OTK board wipes, and Odd-Eyes Arcray Dragon can be Special Summoned from the Extra Deck by tributing 4 Dragons (1 Fusion, 1 Synchro, 1 Xyz, and 1 Pendulum).

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Pendulum Magician and Performapal Skullcrobat Joker engine, as well as the Primite engine for Normal Pendulum Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon, are omitted to keep the Main Deck pure Odd-Eyes.

allow.Sky Iris: The Odd-Eyes Field Spell: it searches any Odd-Eyes card, and its name just lacks the word.
allow.Spiral Flame Strike: Odd-Eyes support: it searches a Level 7 Odd-Eyes or needs an Odd-Eyes card to destroy one.
allow.Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres: Generic Link-2 for two Dragons, part of the page's Vortex endboard.

exclude.Lightning Storm: Needs you to control no face-up cards, and Pendulum Scales are face-up.
exclude.Pot of Prosperity: Banishes Extra Deck cards, where Odd-Eyes keeps its face-up Pendulums.

main: Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon of the Four Heavenly Dragons

Newest support. Scale 4: destroys itself to search a Pendulum Monster with 1500 or less ATK, though your monsters can't activate effects on the field until you Pendulum Summon. Pendulum Summoned, it gains ATK from your Scale gap and doubles its battle damage; destroyed, it returns to the hand.
Odd-Eyes Pendulum Dragon
Scale 4: at the End Phase, destroys itself to search a Pendulum Monster with 1500 or less ATK.
Odd-Eyes Arc Pendulum Dragon
Scale 8 Normal Pendulum: when an Odd-Eyes card you control is destroyed, summons an Odd-Eyes monster from the hand, Deck or GY. The page's Arc Pendulum loop runs on this.
Odd-Eyes Persona Dragon
Scale 1. Quick Effect: negates a monster summoned from the Extra Deck.
Performapal Odd-Eyes Seer
Scale 1: adds a Performapal or Odd-Eyes card from the GY to the hand, then destroys itself, which sets off Arc Pendulum.
Performapal Odd-Eyes Valet
Scale 8. On summon, sends a Performapal or Odd-Eyes monster from the Deck to the GY and copies its Level.
Performapal Odd-Eyes Butler
Scale 2. Special Summons itself from the hand or GY by destroying another of your Odd-Eyes or Performapal monsters.
Odd-Eyes Mirage Dragon
Scale 8. Shields an Odd-Eyes monster from one destruction; when an Odd-Eyes Pendulum is destroyed, swaps another from the Extra Deck into the Scale.
Performapal Odd-Eyes Synchron
Scale 6 Tuner: turns an Odd-Eyes monster into a Level 1 Tuner, or Synchro Summons with a card from the Pendulum Zone, for example into Solblaze.
Odd-Eyes Phantasma Dragon
Scale 0: discard a card to add a face-up Dragon Pendulum from the Extra Deck to the hand.
Odd-Eyes Pendulumgraph Dragon
Ritual or Pendulum Summoned: moves to the Pendulum Zone to negate a Spell effect, then summons an Odd-Eyes from the Extra Deck. Scale 4: fetches Odd-Eyes Advent at the End Phase.
Sky Iris
Field Spell: destroys another face-up card you control to search any Odd-Eyes card, and stops the opponent targeting your Pendulum Scales.
Spiral Flame Strike
Searches a Level 7 Odd-Eyes from the Deck or face-up Extra Deck, or destroys a card while you control an Odd-Eyes card.
Odd-Eyes Fusion
Fusion Summons a Dragon such as Vortex; facing two or more monsters with none of your own, it can use Odd-Eyes from the Extra Deck.
Odd-Eyes Advent
Ritual Spell for Pendulumgraph, Tributing Pendulum Monsters.
extra: Odd-Eyes Override Dragon
Newest support. Link-3 with a Pendulum: destroys one of your cards to draw, and if it was a Pendulum, unlocks a second Pendulum Summon; discards to negate an effect on your turn.
Odd-Eyes Solblaze Dragon
Newest support. Level 8 Synchro Tuner: brings back a face-up Pendulum from the Extra Deck, and revives itself by banishing two Extra Deck-type monsters from the GY.
Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon
Fusion of an Odd-Eyes and a Pendulum: bounces a monster, then negates a Spell, Trap or monster effect.
Odd-Eyes Absolute Dragon
Rank 7: negates an attack and summons an Odd-Eyes; sent to the GY, summons another Odd-Eyes from the Extra Deck.
Odd-Eyes Rebellion Xyz Dragon
Rank 7 for two Level 7 Pendulums: destroys up to two monsters with 3000 or less ATK.
Odd-Eyes Raging Dragon
Rank 7 Dragons; Xyz Summoned on top of another Xyz, it destroys every card the opponent controls.
Odd-Eyes Rebellion Dragon
Rank 7 Dragons; Xyz Summoned on top of another Xyz, it destroys their Level 7 or lower monsters and attacks three times.
Odd-Eyes Meteorburst Dragon
Level 7 Synchro: summons a card from your Pendulum Zone, and stops opposing monster effects during the Battle Phase.
Odd-Eyes Arcray Dragon
Fusion of four Dragons, one each Fusion, Synchro, Xyz and Pendulum: places a Pendulum from the Deck when summoned from the Extra Deck.
Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres
Generic Dragon Link-2: on the opponent's turn, Tributes to bounce a face-up card, and when Tributed, summons a Dragon from the Deck.
